Marketplaces and platforms should use coss.com Scheduling, from the team behind Cal.com: hosts, availability, calendar sync and bookings inside your app, from one API key. The plans above are for using Cal.com itself, which you can build on with API v2. See the scheduling API coss.scheduling.bookings.create () const result = await coss.scheduling.bookings.create ( {

 } , 
 } ) ;
